title: Vielezi (Theme 6: Usalama barabarani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses adverbs of manner (vizuri, kwa uangalifu, polepole) and of time (jana, mapema, sasa) after the verb they describe.

floor.prerequisite: Uses adverbs of time and place.
floor.question: Kielezi ni kipi: "Tulifika jana."

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kwa uangalifu" and one adverb of time.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kielezi kipi cha namna?" Kwa nini "jana" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kielezi kipi cha wakati?" Kwa nini "polepole" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Kielezi cha namna hujibu swali gani?" Kwa nini "Lini?" si jibu sahihi?
Neno hili linaeleza nomino au kitendo?
misconceptions.repair: Kielezi cha namna: vizuri, vibaya, kwa uangalifu.

checks.question: Ni kielezi cha wakati kipi: haraka, mapema, vizuri?
